post.summary: Bulk-invites a set of users, with specific roles, to teams/site/project — either synchronously or via background processing.
post.description:
Blocks duplicate emails, missing roles, invalid project/site/team, and users who already have a pending
invitation or a conflicting assignment. Marks previously-requested teams as no longer requested, then
queues (or runs, if IsBackgroundTask) processing that sends invitation emails, assigns roles, and rejects
the invitee's other pending requests.

post.summary: Approves a pending team-join request, assigning the requester as VendorAdmin/VendorUser (or upgrading an existing VendorUser to VendorAdmin) and finalizing their team setup.
post.description:
Computes and applies the requester's new roles, marks the request Approved, and clears/deletes the
team's requested-team placeholder if no longer needed. Enqueues background work to finalize the team
member record and (conditionally) default lean card and requested-materials creation.

post.summary: Activates or deactivates a user account by re-submitting their existing profile data to UAM with the new active flag.
post.description: Thin wrapper: loads the current User entity, preserves all other fields, and routes through the same update flow as UpdateUser (so it also updates Person/ClmTeamMember).

post.summary: Changes a team member's assigned role on a specific team/site (e.g. promote/demote), updates their permissions, and forces a logout with a role-change notification.
post.description: Only certain target roles are allowed (site manager/planner/construction-manager-mobile/vendor roles); switching directly between a site role and a vendor role in either direction is disallowed.

post.summary: Creates a new platform Admin user with a default password, completes their profile, and provisions a ClmTeamMember record with admin-level email permissions.
post.description: Validation requires the email not already be taken (checked via UAM); throws if UAM user creation fails. The new Person is set inactive pending activation; organization is resolved from the email's domain.

post.summary: Submits a team join request on behalf of a contact person (by email) to a site/team, for a Site Manager/Planner or Vendor Admin.
post.description:
Validation requires the email to already exist as a user, the caller to have a Person record, the target
email to hold SiteManager/SitePlanner/VendorAdmin, and SiteId/ClmTeamId to be valid. Saves a pending
ClmTeamRequest and triggers the join-request-created notification/email flow.

post.summary: Lets the current registered user request to join a vendor team on a given site.
post.description:
Rejected if the site/vendor team don't exist, the user already has an assignment/role at that
project/site/team, or already has a pending request for that team. Saves a pending ClmTeamRequest and
triggers the join-request-created notification/email flow.

post.summary: Bulk-creates CLM teams for a site from a "lean" upload/import, skipping teams that already exist.
post.description: Only creates teams whose id doesn't already correspond to an existing, non-deleted team; existing ones are silently skipped (not updated). On any new team, saves them all and enqueues background team setup and requested-materials creation.

post.summary: Deletes all pending (non-passed) invitations for an email address, and — if the invited user's account is still incomplete — removes that user and all related team/role records entirely.
post.description: Requires an existing invitation for the email that hasn't already passed. Hard-deletes User, Person, ClmTemporaryUserRole and ClmTeamMember for still-incomplete users; the invited user is removed from its ClmUserInvitation (deleting the invitation entirely if it becomes empty).

post.summary: Cancels a pending team-join request (if by the requester) or rejects it (if by an admin/reviewer), cleaning up any now-orphaned requested team.
post.description: The request must currently be Pending. On rejection by someone other than the requester, both parties are emailed the rejection in their preferred languages; a reject comment is then required.

post.summary: Records or revokes a self-registered user's GDPR/terms-and-conditions consent.
post.description:
No-op unless the token's user is both self-registered and incomplete. Approving grants consent, marks the
person's profile complete, and clears role-based access restrictions. Declining hard-deletes the User,
Person, UserRoleMap, and UserTermAndConditionGrant records entirely.

post.summary: Logs out all active sessions belonging to the user identified by the given refresh token.
post.description: The refresh token must correspond to an existing, currently active session. Removes all of that user's active sessions (paged, 500 at a time) from the key store and marks them inactive, then sends a logout notification to the user.

post.summary: Admin-only bulk logout: force-invalidates active sessions across the platform, optionally filtered to mobile-only/web-only devices and/or limited to sessions from the last two months.
post.description: Requires the caller to hold the Admin role. Processes sessions in pages of 500: removes refresh tokens from the key store, marks sessions inactive, and pushes a logout notification per batch. Device type is inferred from the session's device-information string.

post.summary: Marks the current user's unread offline notifications as read, optionally scoped to specific notification response keys.
post.description: Operates only on notifications addressed to the current user that don't already have the user in their read-by list.

post.summary:
Endpoint for sending join request email with site code
This endpoint is used for external clients only
Completes a new/incomplete user's profile on first login: pushes the profile to UAM, applies pending temporary role assignments, and clears previously-failed invitations for their email.
post.description: After the UAM update, refreshes cached dynamic roles and Person/ClmTeamMember data from any pending temporary role, and marks the user's previously-failed invitations as Ignored.

post.summary: Re-triggers the account activation email for an existing, not-yet-active user.
post.description: Requires a matching user that is currently inactive. Delegates to the security service's activation-email resend (forced), and bumps the user's last-update timestamp on success.

post.summary: Resends a failed (non-passed) invitation by deleting the old invitation record and creating and queuing a brand-new one for the same user/role.
post.description: Invitation must exist and not already be Passed. Internally deletes the old invitation, saves a new ClmUserInvitation/ClmInvitedUser, and enqueues background processing to reprocess it.

post.summary: Public self-registration endpoint: creates a new incomplete user account from the submitted profile.
post.description:
Validation confirms the email isn't already taken (via UAM). On success, creates the UAM user, sets the
person's country and marks the profile partially complete, and auto-grants GDPR term acceptance.

post.summary: Sends (or re-sends) a team/site-invitation email to a batch of email addresses for a given site.
post.description: Filters out Admin-user emails and users already assigned at that site/project level. Builds separate email content for already-assigned members vs. brand-new invitees, then sends via the mail service.

post.summary: Invites a batch of users to a project-level role (Project Manager or Project Planner) by locating the corresponding PM/PP team for the project.
post.description: No-op if no matching PM_Team/PP_Team exists for the project, or if InvitedAs isn't ProjectManager/ProjectPlanner. Internally routes through the same invitation flow as AddUsersToTeams.

post.summary: Removes a specific role assignment from a team member, recalculates their remaining roles/domains, and forces the affected user to log out with a notification.
post.description: No-op if the assignment isn't found. Records the removal in unassignment history, updates roles on the User (or temporary role if profile incomplete), updates team/site domain associations, then force-logs-out the user.

post.summary: Updates an existing Admin user's profile in UAM and mirrors the changes to their Person and ClmTeamMember records.
post.description: UserId must already exist, else throws. On success, re-resolves organization from the email domain and updates Person/ClmTeamMember accordingly.

post.summary: Updates a team member's email notification permissions, at global (Admin), site, or project level depending on their assignment scope.
post.description: Requires the target user and their ClmTeamMember record to exist, and the site to exist. Admins have their entire permission set replaced; others get whichever site- or project-level assignment matches updated.

post.summary: Refreshes the current user's ClmTeamMember record with their latest login timestamp and active status.
post.description: No-op if the user or their ClmTeamMember record can't be found. Used to keep team-member listings' "last seen" info current.

post.summary: Lets the currently logged-in user update their own profile details (name, phone, country, image, preferred language).
post.description: Builds an UpdateUserCommand from the caller's existing Email/Active/Roles plus the new fields and routes through the same UAM update path as UpdateUser. If PreferredLanguage is supplied, also updates it on all of the user's ClmTeamMember records.

post.summary: Updates a user's core profile in UAM and mirrors the change to the local Person and ClmTeamMember records.
post.description: If Email differs from the currently stored email, Active is forced to false. Throws if the UAM update call fails or returns errors; on success, also re-resolves the user's organization from the email domain.

post.summary: Adds or removes a material from the current user's favorites list for a given site.
post.description: Rejects adding an already-favorited material or removing one that isn't favorited. Creates the user's ClmUserSetting record on first use if it doesn't exist yet.

post.summary: Bulk creates and/or updates feature-to-role mapping records that drive which roles can see/use which app features.
post.description: Entries whose Id matches an existing FeatureRoleMap are updated in place; entries with no match are inserted as new records. Admin only.

post.summary: Creates a new CLM team (vendor or any other type) or updates an existing one, keeping discipline translations, team groupings, and draft materials in sync.
post.description:
Validates the project/site exists for the given team type, and that Name/Alias are unique within that
scope. On create, enqueues background team setup and (if draft materials are present) requested-materials
creation. On update, re-syncs discipline translations, may trigger draft-material creation if discipline
was newly set, and always upserts the team's grouping(s).

post.summary: Checks whether a proposed team alias is unique within its site/project scope.
post.description: Same validation pattern as M:ClmTeamWebService.Controllers.Query.ClmTeamQueryController.CheckTeamNameIsValid(Queries.TeamNameValidityCheckQuery), applied to the team alias instead of its name.

post.summary: Checks whether a proposed team name is unique within its site/project scope, while creating or renaming a team.
post.description: Comparison is case-insensitive against non-deleted teams, scoped by project for project-level team types or by site for site-level types. Returns false if the name is blank or the site doesn't resolve.

post.summary: Generates a downloadable Excel list of all Admin-role users.
post.description: Side-effecting: pulls all Admin-role persons, builds a localized dataset, and generates/stores an Excel file.

post.summary: Returns counts of join requests, by status, that the current user is authorized to approve/review — for dashboard badges.
post.description: Admin sees all requests. Non-admins get counts built from their ProjectManager (sites in their projects), SiteManager (site teams lacking a vendor admin, or pending vendor teams), and VendorAdmin (own team) scopes, always excluding the caller's own requests.

get.summary: Returns the app/feature map available to a given role, used to drive front-end navigation and feature flags.
get.description: SpecialProjectManager inherits ProjectManager's features. AppUser has "shipments"/"projects" features stripped and gains "user-request". SitePlanner gains "teams.invite_user".

post.summary: Returns a paginated list of team "groupings" for a site (shipment/material team dashboard).
post.description: Callers without admin/PM/site-level roles are restricted to groupings for teams they're personally assigned to as a vendor.

post.summary: Returns an extended profile combining Person, User, ClmTeamMember, and temporary-role data for a given user/person.
post.description: Requires at least one of UserId or PersonId to resolve an existing record; PersonId is preferred to resolve the user. Email permissions are only included when the caller is requesting their own profile.

get.summary: Checks whether the user identified by the given access token has granted GDPR/terms-and-conditions consent.
get.description:
Anonymous endpoint used during onboarding. If the token's email host is not on the allowed list, validation
deletes the associated User/Person/UserRoleMap/UserTermAndConditionGrant records as a side effect.

post.summary: Returns a paginated list of self-registered users within an organization who haven't completed registration, for admin follow-up/cleanup.
post.description: Requires OrganizationId to map to an existing ClmOrganization.

post.summary: Determines which teams an email address can be invited to for a given site or project, accounting for the invited user's existing roles and the caller's own permissions.
post.description:
Validation rejects invalid emails, non-existent sites/projects, targets already assigned to the team/site/project,
targets who are Admin, inactive incomplete self-registered users, or stuck in a failed-invite loop. Candidate teams
are first scoped by the caller's role (admin/PM see all; SitePlanner site-level only; SiteManager excludes SP team;
VendorAdmin only their own vendor teams), then narrowed by the invited user's existing roles/pending requests.

post.summary: Returns a paginated list of pending and past user invitations for a site (invitation status tracker).
Returns full detail of a single team join request for the review/detail screen.
Returns a paginated, role-scoped list of team join requests for approvers to review.
post.description:
Visibility is role-based: Admin/ProjectManager/ProjectPlanner see all requests (optionally filtered by site/team);
SiteManager/SitePlanner/SitePlannerMobile/ConstructionManagerMobile see requests for their site limited to teams
without a VendorAdmin, unless `ShowAllRequest` is set; VendorAdmin sees only requests for their own assigned
teams; any other role gets an empty result.

post.summary: Returns just the total count for the same filtered, role-scoped join-request search as M:ClmTeamWebService.Controllers.Query.ClmTeamQueryController.GetJoinRequestList(Queries.GetJoinRequestListQuery) (used for badges/counters).
Reports each user's most recent login session per device category (Web vs. Mobile), for usage/device analytics.
post.description: Device is inferred from the session's device-information string (Mobile if it contains "android", or both "ios" and "smartphone"; Web otherwise). For each user/device pair, the most recent active session is preferred, falling back to the most recent session overall.

post.summary: Returns the email notification permissions configured for a user at a given site.
post.description: Requires SiteId to exist, and UserId (if provided) to exist. Admin team members get their global permissions; others get their site-specific assignment, falling back to a project-level assignment if no direct site assignment exists.

post.summary: Lists responsible-person contacts for a site (e.g. for shipment sender/recipient pickers), combining regular team-member assignments with manually added additional responsible persons.

get.summary: Suggests sites and vendor teams the current user could self-assign to, based on their email domain and any existing vendor assignments.
get.description: Vendor teams are matched by domain (or where the caller already holds a vendor role on that site), excluding teams already assigned/pending. Sites are filtered to active ones matching whitelisted/user domains, or containing a matched team, excluding sites the caller cannot access.

post.summary: Resolves a site by its site code and lists vendor teams the current user could join there (e.g. via QR/code-based self-join).
post.description:
Requires an active site with code-based joining enabled for the given code, and that the caller doesn't already
hold a higher project/site-level (non-vendor) role there. If the caller is already a vendor on the site, all
remaining unassigned vendor teams are returned; otherwise only domain-matching vendor teams.

post.summary: Returns a paginated, searchable list of CLM teams for a site (team pickers/listing pages), surfacing the caller's own teams first by default.
post.description:
Excludes soft-deleted teams and, unless `RequestedTeamNeeded` is set, teams still pending creation. When no
search/order/type filters are applied, the caller's assigned teams are paged first, followed by the rest.
`RemoveUserAssignedTeams` excludes teams the caller is already assigned to or has a pending request for.

post.summary: Returns a paginated list of team members, either currently assigned to a team or unassigned candidates eligible for assignment to it.
post.description: If the caller is Admin and no SiteIds are given, all sites are considered. `Assigned=true` returns current members (search/filter applied); `Assigned=false` returns members with no matching site/project assignment, i.e. available to assign.

post.summary: Generates a downloadable Excel export of team members for the given sites/team.
post.description: Side-effecting: builds a localized dataset and generates/stores an Excel file rather than just reading data.

post.summary: Broader team lookup for a site, not limited to vendor teams — filterable by team type, for callers that need all team types at once.
post.description: Requires SiteId to resolve to a site; if TeamIds is supplied, every id must be a valid vendor team for that site. The result itself is filtered by `TeamTypes` and is not restricted to vendor teams.

post.summary: Returns a paginated, text-searchable list of teams at a site for the "request to join a team" flow.
Autocomplete-style search for candidate user emails to invite to a project or site/team.
post.description: Branches on `Type`: project-scoped search vs. site/team-scoped search, each building a distinct membership predicate.

post.summary: Lists the authenticated user's own pending/rejected team-join requests.
Returns a paginated list of team members belonging to a given organization, with their team/site/role assignments.

get.summary: Returns the authenticated user's own pending/rejected team-join request status, used to drive UI state.

post.summary: Validates an email address and returns the sites it is a legitimate contact person (SiteManager or VendorAdmin) for.
post.description: Validation confirms the email exists (via UAM) and that the person currently holds a SiteManager/SitePlanner role on an active, accessible site, or a VendorAdmin role on one.

post.summary: Returns a searchable list of vendor teams for a site, optionally restricted to a specific set of team ids.
post.description: Requires SiteId to resolve to a site; if TeamIds is supplied, every id must be a valid, non-deleted vendor team belonging to that site.

get.summary: Health/liveness check for the web service.
get.description: Does not touch any downstream dependency (database, host service, queue) — it only confirms the web service process is up and responding.

post.summary: Runs a named data-read/report operation via `ITeamDataProcessorService` and returns its result.
post.description:
Same reflection-based dispatch as M:ClmTeamWebService.Controllers.TestController.ProcessTeamData(Commands.TeamDataProcessorCommand), but for operations that return data rather than mutate it
(currently only `GetTeamsWithoutDiscipline`, which returns teams missing a discipline assignment). Restricted to admin role.

get.summary: Returns the super-admin/default-password configuration values currently loaded by the service, from both app settings and environment variables.
get.description:
Diagnostic endpoint used to confirm which configuration source (appsettings vs. environment variable) is actually in effect for
the super-admin bootstrap credentials. Restricted to admin role; exposes sensitive credential configuration and should only be used for troubleshooting environment setup.

post.summary: Runs a named one-off data-maintenance/data-fix operation synchronously and returns its result immediately.
post.description:
This is an internal admin utility, not a regular business endpoint. command.ProcessName is used via reflection
to invoke a matching method on `ITeamDataProcessorService` (e.g. deleting stale users, backfilling disciplines/roles,
renaming system teams, populating team groupings, etc. — see `ITeamDataProcessorService` for the full catalog of supported
operations). If no method with that name exists, the command fails with an error. Restricted to admin role.

post.summary: Queues the same named data-maintenance operation as M:ClmTeamWebService.Controllers.TestController.ProcessTeamData(Commands.TeamDataProcessorCommand) for asynchronous execution by the host service, instead of running it inline.
post.description: Use for long-running maintenance operations that would otherwise time out a synchronous HTTP request. Restricted to admin role.

post.summary: Queues a named data-migration operation for asynchronous execution by the host service.
post.description:
Like M:ClmTeamWebService.Controllers.TestController.ProcessTeamData(Commands.TeamDataProcessorCommand) but backed by `ITeamsMigrationService`, which holds one-off migration routines
(e.g. assigning SP mobile roles to sites/warehouses/shipments, backfilling team-based roles across shipments, equipment
bookings, warehouses, etc. — see `ITeamsMigrationService` for the full catalog). Restricted to admin role.

post.summary: Runs a named data-migration operation synchronously, in-process, instead of queuing it to the host service.
post.description: Same dispatch mechanism and operation catalog as M:ClmTeamWebService.Controllers.TestController.ProcessTeamsDataMigration(DataMigration.Commands.TeamsMigrationCommand) (`ITeamsMigrationService`), but executed directly within the web service. Restricted to admin role.

post.summary: Verifies connectivity between the web service and the CLM host service by pushing a message onto the shared queue.
post.description:
Enqueues an empty `TestCommand` onto the configured queue (`ConfigurationConstants.QueueName`) via SeliseBlocks.Genesis.Framework.Infrastructure.IServiceClient.
The host service consumer picks it up asynchronously; this endpoint does not wait for or report on that processing, it only confirms the message was queued.

post.summary: Sends a test push notification to the currently authenticated user.
post.description:
Resolves the caller's user id from the current security context and sends a Infrastructure.Constraints.NotificationType.NotificationTest
notification to that single user via Infrastructure.Services.Contracts.IMessageService, with empty payload/metadata objects. Used to verify the
notification pipeline is wired up correctly, not for any real business notification.
